こんにちは。私はあなたの絵が好きなので、私のキャラクターを描いてほしいです。

月のある夜空の下、威嚇しているような姿を描いてください！下記に背景などを記載しました。ありがとうございました。

https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1osXQpowdDBmKmRIxTrx4nCzc4jeOcozl

Hi there! Thank you for the appeal, I'd love to have you draw my slime Vtuber, Suuren Urushiol!

I leave the expressions, pose, background, and outfit to you!

If able, please have it in 16:9, with background separate. I plan to use this for SNS, if that's okay!

Thank you again for the appeal! I am looking forward to what you make!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1lrwAvPLfiZA6N3_jpI7dXg6VnQbgggOY?usp=sharing

Hello! I'd love for you to draw my character! Any type of pose is okay!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1c-0eVnSPyeG--6ygzCm59cU5sxVWgpF4

Hi! Thank you for your request, your art is beautiful!

I would love for you to draw my OC Mikan! Please draw her however you like. 

Here is her reference and character information (translated): https://imgur.com/a/hKiKX9D
⚠️ Please note her red eye makeup and hard angled earrings. These details are important to me!
Feel free to choose either outfit, or to draw her in something else~

Thank you!

Hello! Thank you for the appeal. I love your artwork, so it makes me happy that you took an interest in my OC! I would love for you to draw my young boy character!

He doesn't smile very often, but he's a very curious boy who gets confused often and he is very silly at times. 

You can decide on the pose. You can also dress him up however you like. You are welcome to draw whatever you like for the background, but hospital and horror themes suit this character well. Thank you for reading.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1_QKR6Qqvc8jHcPrey5Ifi81cG4zAksw_

Hi, I would like a drawing of my male character, Mako. I would really like art of my character inspired by this image of Gawr Gura. I have a version with his hair up and a version with his hair down, feel free to choose either version to draw!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qcKY2tg5n3fCvNOQqgBDdHXwCPfH4KW0?usp=share_link

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qcKY2tg5n3fCvNOQqgBDdHXwCPfH4KW0?usp=share_link

Hello!

. Please choose your favorite character from my references.
∙ Do whatever you want!
I would like a background, but that is optional.
Please keep the layers separate in the .clip file (.psd is ok too)

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rngNTNwLzHxK81-PV3HJ5tS9vHGivpcI?usp=sharing

Good afternoon,

I saw your appeal and I really like your drawings of Yamato from One Piece on your twitter!! I love One Piece as well so it was very cool to see 😊 I thought I would send you a request as a fellow One Piece fan

My character is a rabbit man. He is a strong fighter who likes to dress very well and appear elegant but he is always ready to fight and very arrogant and rude at times. His personality is very surprising to people who do not know him! He battles with a large axe and is the opposite of a nimble and delicate warrior.

Whenever he battles, it is almost like a berserk fury and his fancy clothes are tattered and bloodied. Feel free to design his outfit however you wish to. He uses fancy clothes as a mask to hide his bad personality.

I hope you enjoy drawing him!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xeE_eqPgWbjvu1-y6f5kR4UBul5t0pJ8?usp=sharing

Hello! Thank you so much for appealing! I would love for you to draw my oc!

I can leave the expressions and poses to you!

https://imgur.com/a/KgyOUBM

Hello and my apologies for the extremely late reply to your appeal!

I love your art work and I would love to have you draw my vtuber Panda!

Please feel free to draw her however you like! I would love to see her in any outfit, pose, and expression that you would find fitting for her! 

Thank you so much again!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/154SW7xFsfoX2KqLINmh3mAOG3PzRfM4y?usp=sharing

Thank you for your appeal. I like your illustrations, so I’ll request one.

 Female human. She is shy and cute:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Gt11ZZTf7R_ImKX0-Ab2JAHtKvJQK8aP?usp=sharing
Her breast size is B-C cup. Do not forget the small scar on her nose. And add some make-up (eye-shadow and lipstick). 

The clothing I leave that up to you, but I’ll like it to be something sexy with a mini/short skirt, knee-high socks or stockings with a garter belt, and this necklace and choker (crystal is the same color as her eyes):
https://drive.google.com/file/d/17tjs74VLhG-7P3-AxGA7Vju0ZHzRVHAc/view?usp=sharing

The pose I leave that up to you, but it must be something that shows her thighs with the knee-high socks/stockings with a garter belt. I would also like to have it with a background.
And can you draw it in portrait?

Thanks!

Thank you for the appeal!

I really love your artwork and I would love to see my OC being drawn by you.

Minoru is a polar bear alchemist and she is sweet, friendly and clumsy bear. She is helpful and supportive of her friends and will protect them.

I would love to see her under the night sky and without her outer coat.
I wish to leave the expression and pose up to your creativity please.

Thank you so much! I look forward to it!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ci1_QBGah605Xk4JxLDi17fds0sEG-VJ/view?usp=share_link

Hello, and thank you for the appeal.

I looked through your art, and I love your style! I would love to submit a request.

Could you draw my OC, Daisy? She is a kind-hearted, chubby sheep lady who works as a florist.

Could I request to see her in a beach scene? In the reference link, there is a chibi drawing of her in a swimsuit. Please use that as her outfit.

I would love to see her either playing and splashing in the water, or relaxing on a beach chair drinking from a coconut. You are welcome to choose either pose. In either pose, please include a pair of sunglasses on top of her head. 

Also, it doesn't need to be extreme, but please note that should appear somewhat chubby, particularly around her belly and hips. Her chest should also be large, but it does not need to be excessively so. (Her three sizes are roughly 105-72-109)

Thank you again for appealing!

https://imgur.com/a/2Z092Rc

Hello! I love all your one piece art!!! Thank you for sending me an appeal please draw my vtuber as you like 🫶

Shes a stoic bunny girl who loves hydrangeas and her dog

https://media.discordapp.net/attachments/434240847974891523/1029351751549198347/ARC_OUTFIT3_-FINAL-.png

Hello. Thank you for your request. I would like a drawing of my magical girl. 

She has golden hair with pink highlights. Her eyes should be bright purple and shining. Her color scheme is that of a yellow themed magical girl. Her personality is genki, air headed and bubbly. She's around 17 or 18 years old and with a well-developed chest.

Please draw her with lots of energy or posed as a magical girl might pose. Maybe flying or standing proudly in a field. I would like the background to be something colorful to match her yellow and pink design.

R18 is optional if you'd like to draw a more pin-up or sexy pose.

Thank you

https://imgur.com/a/vo15Rcd

hello! i really love the piece that you drew for me! i was wondering if i could submit another skeb request of the same character.

yuna likes to laugh/smile and has a cool appearance. she's associated with the sunset and cities. i'd like another 16:9 piece with a background. please draw freely! thank you so much!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UkDWZoBWT3iTtT3bsuxGn1a0uaKPO6IJ?usp=share_link
